name: Errol Barrow
contribution: A Barbadian statesman and the first prime minister of Barbados.

checks.lead: Errol Walton Barrow  (21 January 1920 – 1 June 1987) was a Barbadian statesman and the first prime minister of Barbados. Born into a family of political and civic activists in the parish of Saint Lucy, he became a WWII aviator, combat veteran, lawyer, politician, gourmet cook and author. He is often referred to as the "Father of Independence" in Barbados.
